function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, meaning some patients appear in more than one row — specifically, 24 patients were re-tested and appear twice.", "implication": "Since the question asks for the mean across all patients (not across all rows), we must deduplicate the data by keeping only one row per patient. The data dictionary specifies that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for the same patient. Therefore, we must group by `patient_id` and select the row with the maximum `sample_seq` for each patient before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
